Forgent (fgOS) is a platform layer for building and running agent applications, providing the infrastructure, skills, and automation beneath each agent app so developers can build new agents without starting from scratch. It is in alpha and is installed as one small command-line binary, then set up inside an existing git repository. The alpha runs only on Linux (x86_64, glibc 2.35 or later) and Windows 10 or later (x86_64), since macOS and Windows on ARM are not supported yet.
